findings.problem: `backwardHeatCutoff` has no canonical rewrite lemma for the in-region case `z.2 - t₀ < r ^ 2`. The definition is `η z * if z.2 - t₀ < r ^ 2 then backwardHeatTestFunction r (z.1 - x₀) (z.2 - t₀) else 0`. Each proof that needs the in-region value unfolds the whole definition and then uses `simp only [ite_eq_left htime]`. This exact two-line pattern appears in RawI4, CaccioppoliRHS (twice), CaccioppoliEnergy and CaccioppoliEnergyLower (twice, as `simp only [ite_eq_left htime, hη, one_mul]`). I1.lean does the same with `simp only [backwardHeatCutoff, ht, ↓reduceIte]`. There is no stated normal form, so `unfold` exposes the raw `ite` each time. In this file the goal gets unfolded at the point of use, and in the `calc` the `ψ` factor has to be restated by hand.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma next to the definition in Admissibility.lean, for example `backwardHeatCutoff_of_lt (η) {x₀ t₀ r} {z : Vec3 × ℝ} (h : z.2 - t₀ < r ^ 2) : backwardHeatCutoff η x₀ t₀ r z = η z * backwardHeatTestFunction r (z.1 - x₀) (z.2 - t₀)`. Proof: `by simp only [backwardHeatCutoff, if_pos h]`. Mark it `@[simp]` only if the side condition can be discharged by the simp set; otherwise use it as `rw [backwardHeatCutoff_of_lt _ htime]` or `simp only [backwardHeatCutoff_of_lt _ htime]`. A matching `backwardHeatCutoff_of_not_lt` (`= 0` outside the region) would cover the Admissibility.lean uses at lines 77 and 88. Replace lines 94-95 here, and the same pattern in the other files, with this lemma.
findings.benefit: The unfold-then-simp pattern is repeated in at least six places. A single named lemma means the case split on the `ite` is stated once, and the proofs stop depending on how the definition is written. The goal after rewriting is the intended `η w * ψ` form rather than whatever `unfold` leaves behind. If the definition of `backwardHeatCutoff` changes, only one proof needs updating.
